capabilities: query Bases data with SQL in fenced code blocks
render bar, column, pie, doughnut, gauge, line, calendar, and stat charts
compare or merge data from multiple .base files
group and bucket data by date with relative-time functions
configure chart appearance with an inline settings panel
extras: Documents one known SQL limitation around month(today()) bucketing; README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Visualize your Obsidian Bases data as charts — directly inside your notes.
problem: Bases displays vault data as tables and lists, but offers no way to visualize that data as charts inside notes.

relations.evidence: Drop these in a 3-column layout (e.g. the Dashboards plugin) for a tidy summary strip

summary: Chart renderer that turns Obsidian Bases data into bar, pie, gauge, line, calendar-heatmap, and stat charts via SQL queries in code blocks.
